slides.title: Quality Over Activity Volume
bullets: Field medical excellence separates a busy MSL from an effective one
MSLs get only a handful of substantive meetings per year with top KOLs
Every one of those meetings has to count

slides.title: Prepare With a Specific Objective
bullets: Every interaction needs a clear, specific objective
Not "check in with Dr. X" but a precise question to resolve
Undirected visits waste both the MSL's and the expert's time

slides.title: Make It Genuinely Two-Way
bullets: Treat every interaction as a chance to learn, not just to present
An MSL who only presents data is a walking slide deck, not a peer
This is the insight-generation dimension covered in Module 5

slides.title: Follow Through, Every Time
bullets: Log the interaction accurately and promptly
Follow up on commitments — papers, introductions, escalations
Make sure the insight actually reaches people who can act on it
Excellence that stops at the meeting has only half done the job

slides.title: Don't Over-Index on Famous KOLs
bullets: A well-known expert can absorb huge time for little real dialogue
Competency frameworks define what "good" looks like at each stage
The real question is how much scientific value moved both ways

slides.title: Build the Reputation Early
bullets: Clear objectives, real dialogue and follow-through build trust fast
Faster than simply maximising the number of visits logged each month

takeaway.title: Field medical excellence is defined by quality of exchange, not visit count
bullets: Preparation, two-way dialogue and follow-through are the three disciplines
Competency frameworks keep quality consistent across a team
The measure is how much genuine scientific value moved in both directions
